about: The lists the player (Lua), gyroflow-export (Rust) and the Library (Rust and its page's JS) share, kept here once and read by each: registry.lua in the player, include_str! in vs-gyroflow and the Library (afp_catalog::registry's types), window.AFP_LISTS in the Library's page (main.rs puts it there before the page's scripts run). Order matters wherever a list is an array. CLAUDE.md, 'The same logic is in more than one language'; tests/registry_test.py checks each side reads it.
curves_about: The log curves, in Ctrl+l's order (log: in the round, offered as a source's curve by the Library), and the underwater colour, which the player shows as one (not in the round, never a source's saved curve). id: what everything names it by (a clip's own file, --curve). name: the player's and the Library's. export_name: gyroflow-export's, where it's another. lut: gyroflow-export's LUT to HLG (luts/), none where it's made per clip. hdr / sdr: the player's shaders to HLG and the maker's to Rec.709; maker, maker_lut: whose that one is.

curves.name: D-Log M
curves.maker_lut: DJI's D-Log M to Rec.709 LUT 11.17, for the Osmo Action 6, downloaded from DJI's site at setup

export_about: An export's settings (docs/export-settings.md), the player's (exportsettings.lua) and the Library's Share (share.js, renders.rs's recipe). Each setting's choices in order, the first its default: the defaults are what was exported before these settings existed, so a recipe keeps only the others and its hash stays. kinds: the settings each kind of file has. flag: gyroflow-export's option for it (quality is a preset of several). photo_radius_max: the radius a photo is cleaned up from at its best (vs-gyroflow still.rs MAX_RADIUS).

choices.label: Fast
choices.note: the encoder's real-time mode, the source's bit rate

choices.label: Quality
choices.note: the encoder's quality mode, 1.5× the bit rate

choices.label: As displayed
choices.note: As this computer plays it: Performance & Quality's temporal denoise and edges

choices.label: Quickest
choices.note: Each at its lightest: no temporal denoise, the frame's edge spread out, fringes left, bilinear

choices.label: Highest
choices.note: Each at its best: the full temporal denoise, the trail at the edges, Lanczos; photos cleaned up from 7 frames each side

settings_about: What a clip is read as and shown with (transform.lua, renders.rs), key by key, in order within each group. group: bundle (the transform, kept whole), uw (the underwater colour: the source's, in a render's settings only when on), input (the source's own correction), opts (the computer's, gyroflow.conf's, in a render's recipe as opts). kind: enum (one of values), bool, number (min-max), ratio (one of values, or any W:H landscape-wise). neutral: what a bundle from before the key existed plays as. project: a Gyroflow project owns it. conf / conf_default: gyroflow.conf's option and the plugin's default for it; not_in_conf: values the option can't take (the default instead). recipe: in the Library's render recipe. exported: gyroflow-export takes it, as cli says (player_only otherwise, with why). gpu: its field in the warp's request to gyroflow-gpu-table (gyroflow/main.lua player_args), where it has one.
settings_json_about: The settings JSON (docs/reference/contracts.md, 'The settings'): one object saying how a clip is shown, built once by the player and taken as-is by gyroflow-gpu-table (its request is the settings with what only playback adds: request) and by gyroflow-export (--settings), for an export, a photo, a Live Photo, a moment, a 360 export, the Library's renders. The player builds it for the clip playing (gyroflow/main.lua gpu_settings, published as user-data/gyroflow/settings) and for a saved view (gyroflow/settings.lua of_view). Missing keys mean the default. table: gyroflow-gpu-table reads it. export: gyroflow-export reads it (vs-gyroflow gyroflow-export/options.rs apply_settings), as cli says on its command line; not: why it doesn't. request: not a setting, what playback adds to the table's request (or asks per request). example: a value, for the tests. tests/settings_json_test.py: export.lua builds no flag a key here stands for.

own_folders_about: The folders the player and the Library make in a project (and earlier versions made), lower case: left out of its footage wherever it's listed (#128). recycle_bins: the NAS's, never footage either (the walks skip # names anyway).
